questions.text: For each of the items (i) - (x) , choose the correct answer from the given alternatives and write its letter beside the item number in the answer booklet provided.

Your friend asks you to write his personal information at the back of his diary. What is the suitable term for such information? References Autobiography Bibliography Abstract Biography Choose Answer : - -
Which of the following is the correct expression? I am as tall as him I am as tall with him I am as tall like him I am tall as like him I am tall as he Choose Answer : - -

“I have been playing for five hours.” What would be the correct statement if the event was completed at the moment of speaking? I have playing for five hours I had played for five hours I played for five hours I play for five hours I plays for five hours Choose Answer : - -
The cards expressing sympathy for the demise of somebody are refered to as: Best wishes cards Condolence cards Invitation cards Sadness cards Ceremonial cards Choose Answer : - -

The following are the uses of the dictionary except: identifying the usage of a given word knowing how a word is pronounced understanding the correct spelling of a word showing the number of words of a language understanding the meaning of the given word Choose Answer : - -

Fidelis likes neither fish nor beef. This statement implies that; Fidelis likes Fish but dislikes beef Fidelis likes both beef and fish Fidelis dislikes fish but likes beef Fidelis dislikes beef but likes fish Fidelis dislikes both fish and beef Choose Answer : - -

In the sentence “He is always shouting at his wife.” The action of shouting takes place: now and then only at the time of speaking over a longer period of time in a near future in a near past Choose Answer : - -

The following sentences express future plans except: The president is addressing the nation tonight I am going to drive to work today They read both documents I will be at work on that time I might visit serengeti if it does not rain heavily Choose Answer : - -

When the school closes, Zuhura will visit her paternal uncle who lives at Ikwiriri. What does the term paternal uncle mean? Her aunt’s husband Her father’s brother Her uncle from aunt’s father Her mother’s brother Her uncle from aunt’s mother Choose Answer : - -

When you write an official letter, you do not write the name of the writer’s address. Why is it so? It normally appears at the bottom It is not part of official information It is not part of the letter It confuses the addressee It is too long to fit in the address Choose Answer : - -

Although the headmaster offered the trip to Ngorongoro but the student refused to go. You can see I am busy right now. Do not west my time. I must go to the farm despite of the rain. That is the man which came here yesterday. My friend is to weak too run 15 km. My sister was singing while I danced. We planned to travel on ship. I usually sleep on bed. View Ans

Fill in the blanks with either say or tell to complete the following sentences. Ali __________ goodbye to me and left. Please __________ us about your holiday. Did you have a nice time? Don’t just stand there! __________ something. Please __________ everyone about our journey. Fatuma __________ me that he was fed up with his job. Never __________ it again! They will chase you away. Don’t __________ anybody what you have seen. Did she __________ you what happened? My sister couldn’t help me. She __________ me to ask Janeth. View Ans
The language of poems is quite different from the language of normal conversation. Verify this statement using two poems you have read in this section. Give three points from each poem. View Ans

The African society is gifted with highly conscious people with liberated minds. Show the truth of this statement with reference to two plays you have read in this section. Give three points from each play. View Ans
Mistreating others is morally bad because it makes them upset. With reference to two novels, explain the truth of this assertion. Give three points from each novel. View Ans
